<!-- pr-reviewer: bde0e459bc7f70b043e64572aa8f4db7af256e65 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking findings.

Reviewed locally after a clean trial merge with upstream/main `97a880c53e0f8158348410dac152db4ca99f277c`.
The review uses the AGENTS.md from that main commit.
No GitHub runner ran.

What looks good:

- The three cases show all five requested turning kinds.
- Each script embeds its models and checks verification before posting.
- The case notes state the partial bore, prepared taper stock and holder limits.
- No production guard, importer, UI source, dependency or process file changes.

Build and tests:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed. The full `example_catalog` suite passed all 26 tests.
- Each new case passed both regeneration and script rebuild tests.
- `cargo xtask catalog --check`: passed all nine cases.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --only 'app heavy: example_catalog'`: passed the release build and lane command.
  The lane ran zero tests, with 26 filtered out. This suite has no ignored tests.

Extra suites run:

- The fixture reader search found `crates/ui/tests/catalog_render.rs`.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test catalog_render`, from `crates/ui`: two passed, one ignored.
  The default tests opened and framed all catalog cases.
  The ignored test is the optional screenshot renderer.
- No importer code or STEP fixture changes. The extra kernel STEP suites do not apply.

Safety-tier checks:

- Read all 682 new NC lines: bushing 36, contour-finishes 620, taper-finish 26.
- Checked operation order, G18, diameter coordinates, feeds, retracts and program endings.
- Regeneration and script rebuilds reproduced the NC files byte for byte.
- Independently checked all five OBJ meshes for closed edges and positive volume.
- Repeated two case-removal mutations against `turning_cases_cover_five_additional_kinds`:
  - Remove `turning/bushing`: RED at the named missing-case assertion. Restore it: GREEN.
  - Remove `turning/contour-finishes`: RED at the named missing-case assertion. Restore it: GREEN.
- Both mutations were restored. The trial-merge tree has no remaining edits.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes:

- The contour program contains repeated zero-length feed blocks. These do not block this catalog change.
- No machine prove-out ran. Holder bodies remain unmodelled, as the case notes state.
- No UI source changes. Before/after UI screenshots are not required for this diff.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
